title.narrative: Second Financial Sector Program Cluster - Subprogram 4

description.narrative: The overall impact of the FSP II is a sound, market-based finance sector to enhance resource mobilization and support sustainable economic growth. The expected outcome is a growing, resilient, and efficient financial system. Continuing the reforms initiated under subprograms 1, 2, and 3, subprogram 4 has nine key reform actions (triggers) that the government began implementing in January 2010. At the conclusion of subprogram 4, the following outputs will have been accomplished under the FSP II cluster: (1) Improved Confidence and Financial Intermediation, (2) Maintained Stability in the Finance Sector, (3) Promoted Good Governance, and (4) Enhanced Efficiency in the Finance Sector.

description.narrative: A growing, resilient, and efficient financial system

Increased number of qualified Kampuchea Institute of Certified Public Accountants and Auditors members by 2011 (10 in 2006) Data Source: Reports from the National Accounting Council and Kampuchea Institute of Certified Public Accountants and Auditors
Ratio of nonperforming loans to total loans of banks maintained below 10.0% (9.8% in 2006) Data Source: Published audited reports of banks, MFIs, and insurance firms

All banks and MFIs meet minimum capital adequacy requirements set by regulatory authorities Data Source: Economic reports and statistics published by regulatory authorities and other international development agencies
Access to credit by the total population to reach 6% by 2010 (3% in 2006) Data Source: Progress reports from NBC
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Improved confidence and financial intermediation. Modernized payments, clearance, and settlement system (PCSS) Indicator: PCSS upgraded, including standardized checks and a more efficient check clearing system by 2011 Data Source: Reports of NBC: coordinated payment system working group including banks

Output: 2. Maintain stability in the finance sector. Strengthened bank supervision capacity and measures adopted to sustain financial stability Indicator: Trained staff to monitor implementation of Basel I requirements and undertake on-site inspection of banks once a year Data Source: NBC report on assessment of capacity building needs

Output: 3. Promote good governance. International initiatives on anti-money laundering and combating the financing of terrorism promoted Indicator: Functioning CAFIU with at least 20 suspicious transactions reports processed by 2010 Data Source: Official copy of adopted anti-money-laundering prakas and reports from the CAFIU

Output: 4. Enhance efficiency in the finance sector. Key operating functions of NBC fully computerized and integrated Indicator: NBC operating an integrated management information system by 2010 Data Source: Final report confirming successful installation, testing of software systems, training of staff on use of application
